urls.title: Websites or domains
urls.description: One website per line, e.g. acme.com or https://www.acme.com. Duplicates (same domain) are skipped.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: Homepage plus the most likely contact pages (Contact, About, Impressum, Legal, Team). 1 = homepage only. Max 15.

onlyWithContacts.title: Only output websites with contacts
onlyWithContacts.description: If on, websites where nothing was found (or that failed to load) are left out. You are only charged for websites with contacts either way.

emailDomainOnly.title: Only emails on the website's own domain
emailDomainOnly.description: Drop emails on other domains (e.g. gmail.com, agency addresses) and keep only name@company-domain.

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobots.description: Skip subpages that the website's robots.txt disallows.

concurrency.title: Parallel websites
concurrency.description: How many websites to scan at the same time.

timeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a page after this many seconds.
